ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the map and answer the following questions. <image1> The coastal precipitation in the two places M and N in the map is different; this is mainly related to the difference in which atmospheric condition?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the map shows the North Atlantic and the regions on both of its shores; the left side is near the east coast of North America, and the right side is near Europe—the west coast of Africa; M is located on the mid-latitude coast of the east coast of North America, and N is located on the subtropical coast of northwest Africa. Both are near the sea, but the latitude zones and circulation backgrounds they are in are different. Then reason: differences in coastal precipitation do not depend only on whether a place is near the sea, but are also related to atmospheric circulation conditions such as prevailing winds, pressure belts and wind belts, and ascending or descending air currents. M is relatively more easily affected by mid-latitude westerlies, cyclone activity, or moist maritime air currents, while N is relatively more easily affected by the subtropical high, trade wind belt, and descending air currents, making it relatively dry. Therefore, the difference in coastal precipitation between M and N is mainly related to the difference in atmospheric circulation.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the map and answer the following questions.

<image1>

The coastal precipitation in the two places M and N in the map is different; this is mainly related to the difference in which atmospheric condition?

method.method_draft: 先读图：图示为北大西洋及两岸区域，M位于北美东岸中纬度沿海附近，N位于非洲西北部副热带沿海附近，二者虽都临海但纬度带和所处环流带不同。再读题：题目问的是“M、N两地沿海降水不同，主要与哪种大气条件差异有关”。运用降水形成规则：沿海降水多少不仅看是否临海，还取决于盛行风、气压带风带、上升或下沉气流等大气环流条件；M更容易受中纬西风、气旋活动或来自海洋的湿润气流影响，N更容易受副热带高压、信风带或下沉气流影响而干燥。因此应归纳为“大气环流不同”。
